create_adabelief_optimizer: create an AdaBelief optimizer instance with custom learning rate and beta parameters for model training
configure_adabelief_from_config: build an AdaBelief optimizer from a Config object and PyTorch model using the from_config class method
reset_adabelief_state: reset the optimizer state including step counters and exponential moving averages for all parameter groups
step_adabelief_optimization: perform a single optimization step with optional closure for loss computation and gradient updates
enable_adabelief_features: configure AdaBelief with weight decoupling, rectified updates, or AMSGrad variant options for advanced training
